thingsToDo.title: Kanahā Beach Park
thingsToDo.description: Kanahā Beach Park is a beach park in or near Kahului, Hawaii. Kanahā Beach Park is a coastal park near Kahului Airport known for windsurfing, kitesurfing, and broad beach access. The area includes recreation facilities and offshore conditions that made it a central site in modern Maui watersports development. The site is regularly referenced in statewide historical, environmental, or cultural documentation.

thingsToDo.title: ʻĪao Valley State Monument
thingsToDo.description: ʻĪao Valley State Monument is a state park in or near Kahului, Hawaii. ʻĪao Valley State Monument is a protected valley park in central Maui featuring the ʻĪao Needle and streamside rainforest scenery. The valley is historically significant in Hawaiian political history, including the 1790 Battle of Kepaniwai. The site is regularly referenced in statewide historical, environmental, or cultural documentation.

thingsToDo.title: Maui Arts & Cultural Center
thingsToDo.description: Maui Arts & Cultural Center is a performing arts center in or near Kahului, Hawaii. The Maui Arts & Cultural Center in Kahului is Maui's principal performing arts and exhibition venue, opened in 1994. Its campus hosts concerts, theater, visual arts, and festivals that serve both local audiences and island-wide cultural programming. The site is regularly referenced in statewide historical, environmental, or cultural documentation.

thingsToDo.title: Alexander & Baldwin Sugar Museum
thingsToDo.description: Alexander & Baldwin Sugar Museum is a industrial history museum in or near Kahului, Hawaii. Alexander & Baldwin Sugar Museum in Puʻunēnē interprets Maui's plantation and sugar industry history through machinery, photographs, and labor archives. The museum documents how large-scale agriculture shaped land use, migration, and economic development in central Maui. The site is regularly referenced in statewide historical, environmental, or cultural documentation.

thingsToDo.title: Maui Nui Botanical Gardens
thingsToDo.description: Maui Nui Botanical Gardens is a botanical garden in or near Kahului, Hawaii. Maui Nui Botanical Gardens in Kahului is a nonprofit garden focused on native Hawaiian plants and Polynesian-introduced canoe plants. Its collections emphasize dryland species conservation, education, and practical landscape guidance suited to Maui's climate. The site is regularly referenced in statewide historical, environmental, or cultural documentation. Its present-day access and management context shape how residents and visitors use the area.

bestTimeToVisit.title: Shoulder seasons are typically easiest in Kahului
bullets: Spring and fall usually offer comfortable weather and smoother logistics.
Reserve popular tours and timed attractions early in busy periods.
Use morning starts for major sights and photo-heavy locations.

travelTips: Group activities by area to reduce transfers across Kahului.
Pre-book top tours and high-demand attractions when your dates are set.
Leave one flexible time block each day for weather and local recommendations.

faq.q: How many days should I plan for Kahului?
faq.a: Two to three days is enough for core Kahului highlights plus one or two local experiences.

faq.q: Should I book tours ahead in Kahului?
faq.a: Yes—advance booking is recommended for weekends, holidays, and top-rated operators.
